The review loop

A decision is useful
when it can be traced.

01

Identity

Check the passport and proof of address, including expiry, before anything else can be approved.

02

Ownership

See who owns the client and which other clients share the same beneficial owner.

03

Screening

Review fictional PEP, sanctions and adverse-media hits and record a reason for every decision.

04

Source of wealth

Compare the declared wealth with the documents that support it, and see the gap.

05

Funding checks (AML)

Open the funding alerts raised on the first money in, and review them on the alert investigation page.

06

Human decision

An analyst records a rating and approves, rejects or asks for information. High-risk files need a second approver, and the audit trail is kept.
